notes.title: Halloween is coming to One Military Camp
notes.notes:
Enjoy Spooky season in this base building/ strategy game from Abylight Barcelona. Now you have the opportunity to build your camp, recruit and train soldiers, specialize and carry out missions in enemy territory… with a twist. 

We celebrate Halloween with new free content including pumpkins, mausoleums, scarecrows and many other elements to customize your camp.

Halloween update is the latest addition to our award-winning management game, after sandbox mode, full customization, self sufficiency mechanics and multiplayer. Now its the perfect time to try it and have fun  with nightmarish in-game items. 

One Military Camp is Out Now, check our Steam page: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1743830/One_Military_Camp/

notes.title: Cursed Castilla Steam Scream 2023 update!
notes.notes:
To all the brave knights of Tolomera, Cursed Castilla has been updated with many improvements and features, including:

- Some adjustments here and there.
- Improved support for gamepads and controllers.
- Added support for 11 different languages.
- Better menu graphics.
- Verified Steam Deck check.

For the glory of arcade times!

notes.title: Maldita Castilla EX for Steam Awards
notes.notes:
Call to the entire community of gamers (and retro game lovers) to vote for Maldita Castilla EX for the Steam Awards (Labor of Love category)!

Cursed Castilla (Maldita Castilla EX) is an arcade action platformer full of creatures from medieval myths from Spain and the rest of Europe, as well as from chivalric romances. This game is an extended version of the renowned classic arcade Maldita Castilla, originally created by the indie Locomalito.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Fight against 48+ types of enemies and 19 final bosses
[*] Brag about your combat skills with 15 unlockable achievements
[*] Yell your battle cry with songs for the original soundtrack and the remastered audio
[*] Revive the glory of the arcade times with 10 different screen view modes
[/list]

Prepare yourself for a journey into the [b]Cursed Castilla Ex[/b], the extended version of the acclaimed arcade classic Maldita Castilla, created originally by the Spanish developer Locomalito - in collaboration with Abylight Studios.[img]

notes.title: Indie SHMUP Super Hydorah releases on Sept 20 on Steam
notes.notes:
Hey guys! After release the homage to best classic arcades Cursed Castilla, we come back with Super Hydorah,an indie shoot’em up that condense the best of the classics of the genre in an intense non-linear gameplay experience.

The game will be released on September 20th for 11,99 $/€ and you can add the game to your wishlist [url= http://store.steampowered.com/app/628800/Super_Hydorah/]NOW [/url]

Stand ready for the battle that will decide the future of the universe! Prepare your weapons and start your engines: only you, the best trained and most lethal pilot in the galaxy, can face the Meroptian menace. Abylight and Locomalito are excited to announce that Super Hydorah Super Hydorah will be released on September 20th for Steam, for a price of $11,99 / €11,99 and similar prices around the world. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26613835/8662081745831b3c2112b26e50be1f08dfbbc52a.gif[/img]

Super Hydorah is a side scroller non-linear SHMUP which gives the player a challenging experience with the best from the greatest classics of the genre: straightforward action, old school visuals and a wide array of content with unique space settings. Super Hydorah pays homage to the 16 and 32 bits era with its art style and an original soundtrack with more than 60 songs. Also, its gameplay gives yet another turn of the screw to the SHMUP genre, with an extremely precise control and 21 non linear levels, divided into 35 sublevels, and different gameplay modes.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pi-xu06RdO8


Are you ready to test your skills as a pilot and save the galaxy?

notes.title: Super Hydorah, our next game, is on Greenlight! Please, support us!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.abylight.com/presskit/greenlight/imagen_595.gif[/img] 

The most challenging shmup of the Spanish indie scene is preparing to land on Steam. Only you, our most skilled and deadly pilot of the galaxy, can help the Delta Force fighter ships to face the menace of the Meroptians, a race of biomechanical beings who attacked the star Omnios and put the whole galaxy in danger.

Super Hydorah is designed to offer a challenging and memorable experience, with the wisdom and richness of traditional shmup classics like R-Type, Gradius or Turrican as its foundations. It’s a game just like the retro classics: straightforward entertainment which dares the player in every stage; a wide set of different combat situations with unique content that will surprise you and keep you engaged for hours. Super Hydorah is a non-linear game, and there are alternative routes – with multiple endings for better replayability. You will have to become a true master of space warfare with your Delta Lance in order to unveil all the secrets and alternative routes of this intense SHMUP!

And that’s not all: Super Hydorah features both single and cooperative multiplayer modes. In its intense co-op mode, you will have to work together with a friend in order to overcome the Meroptian threat!

If you feel like supporting us, please, visit our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=893196793] Greenlight page[/url] and give us your YES. Help Super Hydorah get Greenlit!

notes.title: Ghosts n Goblins n Gonks: Cursed Castilla Released
notes.notes: Cursed Castilla [official site], an expanded version of Locomalito’s ace Maldita Castilla, has arrived on PC for more Ghosts ‘n Goblins-y, Tiger Road-ish shooty platforming action. It improves on the original with new levels, new enemies, new bosses, a new illustrated bestiary, new songs, and remastered audio – it’s the fancy polished commercial version of a game that was already really quite pleasant. This revamp (also known as Maldita Castilla EX) hit Xbone first but is now back home, soaked in pixel art ichor. Here, check out the launch trailer: … [visit site to read more]
